Title: Deactivate (Pattern Only)/Activate
Content: Objective Deactivated Patterns are considered nonexistent in the 3D window. Therefore the rest of the Patterns simulate through the deactivated Patterns. The general use of the function is to prevent complicated details, such as pleats or slits, from collapsing. When deactivating specific Patterns, the Simulation speed gets faster as it excludes them from the calculation. Location 3D Toolbar Select/Move 3D Garment Right-Click Pop-up Menu Deactivate (Pattern Only) / Activate 2D Toolbar Transform Pattern 2D Pattern Right-Click Pop-up Menu Deactivate (Pattern Only) / Activate Operation Follow the indicated guideline: 3D Toolbar Select/Move 3D Garment Right-Click Pop-up Menu Deactivate (Pattern Only) / Activate 2D Toolbar Transform Pattern 2D Pattern Right-Click Pop-up Menu Deactivate (Pattern Only) / Activate The selected Pattern is now being deactivated/activated. Note: 3D Statement

Title: Select/Move (3D)
Content: Objective Select and move Patterns in the 3D window. Location Main Menu 3D Garment Select/Move 3D Toolbar Select/Move Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 3D Garment Select/Move 3D Toolbar Select/Move Click and drag a part of the 3D Garment while the Simulate tool is activated. The 3D Garment moves naturally, and you may fine-tune your 3D Garment. Or, click and drag a part of the 3D Garment while the Simulate tool is deactivated. Convert the 3D window to pattern arrangement mode and move the Garment as Patterns.

Title: Roll Up (ver. 12.2)
Content: Feature Overview Makes it easier to fold the ends of garments, such as sleeve openings, pants openings, etc. Steps 1. Select an outline of the 2D pattern with the Edit Pattern tool. - Roll Up does not work on outlines contains a sewing relationship to another pattern. - Roll Up might not work on some segment lines as this feature is optimized for sleeve openings and pants openings that creates a tube. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below. - In 2D Window select a segment line, Right Mouse Button click Roll Up 3. The Roll Up dialog box appears. Enter the desired input. Number of Roll Up Set the number of Roll up to 3 times. Distance Enter a minimum of 10mm and a maximum of 200mm as the distance of each roll up Reset While the dialog box is running, reset the applied Roll Up. Returning the garment to its original state. Apply Apply Roll Up based on the input values entered. Close Close the Roll Up dialog box. - Once you enter the Number of Roll Up and Distance, a green circle will be displayed at the end position of the final garment in the 3D Window as a preview. - Roll Up does not apply symmetrically or to instance modifications. End Result Select Close at the bottom of the dialog to exit Roll Up. - If the Particle Distance of the pattern being rolled up is over 10mm, it will be automatically adjusted to 10 for stable simulation.

Title: Steam
Content: Objective Shrink or stretch Fabric partially like as using a steam iron. Location Main Menu Materials Steam Steam 2D Toolbar Steam Operation Steam Setting Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Materials Steam Steam 2D Toolbar Steam All Patterns are now being displayed in mesh. The Steam Brush appears at the top-left corner of the 2D window. Set the value as desired. Shrinkage Sets the shrinkage level. Size Sets the size of the brush. Hardness Sets the hardness of the steam. Click and drag on desired area to steam. According to the shrinkage, the selected area is now being displayed in light-blue or orange. Activate the Simulate. Remove Steam Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Materials Steam Steam 2D Toolbar Steam Right-click on a pattern to remove steam, and select either Remove Steam on Selected Pattern or Remove All Steam. The steam is now being deleted accordingly. Note: It can also be removed from the same right-click pop-up menu with Edit Pattern or Transform Pattern tools.

Title: Trace as / Convert to Internal Shape
Content: Objective Use the Trace function to convert selected lines/shapes or areas into Internal Lines/Shapes. Location 3D Toolbar Edit Line (3D Pattern) Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Toolbar Edit Line (3D Pattern) Click on created Baselines or Internal Lines on 3D Garment. The selected Baselines or Internal Lines are now highlighted in yellow. Right-click on the selected Baselines or Internal Lines. A Pop-up menu appears. Select Trace as Internal Shape or Convert to Internal Shape in the pop-up menu. The selected Baselines or Internal Lines are now being traced as /converted to Internal Shapes.

Title: Unfold Symmetric Editing (with Sewing) (ver5.1.0)
Content: Objective Edit a single pattern symmetrically based on its center line. Location Unfold Symmetric Editing (with Sewing) Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on Line) Unfold Symmetric Editing with Sewing Remove Linked Editing Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern) Remove Linked Editing Operation Unfold Symmetric Editing (with Sewing) 1. Select a Pattern Outline with the ____2.jpg Edit Pattern tool. 2. Follow the indicated path below: Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on Line) Unfold Symmetric Editing with Sewing The pattern unfolds as a symmetric pattern based on the selected line. Remove Linked Editing 1. Select a Pattern with the ____3.jpg Transform Pattern tool. 2. Follow the indicated path below: Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern) Remove Linked Editing The linked editing is removed. Note: Can edit Symmetric center line (ver MD10)

Title: Rotate
Content: Objective Rotate Patterns and Internal Shapes/Lines based on various references. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern Operation Rotate Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern Select the Pattern or Internal Shapes/ Lines or Baselines to be rotated. The marquee box appears around the selected item. Click and drag the rotate point on top of the marquee box. The selected item rotates towards the mouse. Note: While clicking and dragging the Pattern, Internal Shapes/Lines, or Baselines, right click to access the Rotate window. Type in the desired angle, then click OK. The selected item rotates based on the entered value (ver3.2.0). Clockwise/Counterclockwise Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern Click on the Pattern or Internal Shapes/Lines to be rotated. Then, right click to access the pop-up menu. When the pop-up menu appears, select Clockwise (45º) or Clockwise (90º) or Counterclockwise (45º) or Counterclockwise (90º) The selected pattern rotates according to the chosen options. X/Y Axis Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern Click on the Pattern or Internal Shapes/Lines to be rotated. Then, right click to access the pop-up menu. When the pop-up menu appears, select X-Axis or Y-Axis. Select the line of a Pattern which should be rotated to the chosen axis. The selected Pattern or Internal Shapes/Lines are rotated to X-Axis or Y-Axis on the basis of the selected line. Parallel To Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern Click on the Pattern or Internal Shapes/Lines to be rotated. Then, right click to access the pop-up menu. When the pop-up menu appears, select Parallel to... Select the line of any Patterns or Internal Lines/Shapes in the 2D window which the previously selected Pattern or Internal Shapes/Lines are rotated to. This line acts as a fiducial line. The selected line turns red. Then, select the line of the rotating Pattern or Internal Shapes/Lines that will rotate parallel to the fiducial line selected above. The Pattern or Internal Shapes/Lines rotates parallel to the fiducial line.

Title: Order
Content: Objective When you create Patterns in the 2D window, the last Pattern created is placed on the front by default. Change the order of the Patterns as needed. Location Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern/Internal Line/Shape) Order Bring Forward / Bring to Front / Send Backward / Send to Back Operation Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the Transform Pattern tool or the Edit Patterntool. Select the Pattern or Internal Line or Shape to be reordered. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern/Internal Line/Shape) Order Bring Forward / Bring to Front / Send Backward / Send to Back The selected object is reordered.

Title: Distribute
Content: Objective Distribute Patterns or/and Internal Shapes/Lines by designated intervals (ver2.5.0). Location Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern/Internal Line/Shape) Distribute Horizontally/Vertically Operation Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the Transform Pattern tool or the Edit Pattern tool. Select two or more Patterns or/and Internal Lines/Shapes. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern/Internal Line/Shape) Distribute Horizontally/Vertically The Distribute Window appears. Enter the desired Spacing value and select OK. The selected Patterns and/or Internal Lines/Shapes are distributed horizontally or vertically by the designated intervals.

Title: Match 2D Pattern Measurements
Content: Objective Match up the pattern line lengths of two corresponding pattern outlines or segment points (ver3.0.0). Location Match Up with Pattern Outlines Right-Click the Pop-Up Menu (on Segment) Match Up To Start/ To Center/ To End Match Up with Points Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Point) Match Up Operation Match up with Pattern Outlines Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the Edit Pattern Tool. Select Pattern outlines of two separate Patterns that are intended to be aligned with each other. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on Segment) Match Up To Start / To Center / To End The Patterns align to the Pattern outline that is right clicked on. Match Up with Points Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the Edit Pattern Tool. Select two points from the two Patterns that are intended to be aligned with each other. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on Point) Match Up The Patterns will align in reference to the point that is right clicked on first. Match Measurement (ver. 2024.0) Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the Edit Pattern Tool. Select Pattern outlines from the two separate Patterns that should be aligned adjacent to each other. Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on Segment) Match Up Match Measurement Set the options as needed and then click the OK button. Match to Choose the reference of the two segments. Direction Select the direction in which the segment will be edited. Measurement The length of the segment to be matched is displayed. The two line segments will be matched according to the setting options selected.

Title: Align
Content: Objective Align Patterns and Internal Shapes based on various standards (ver2.5.0). Location Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern/ Internal Shape) Align Left/ Center/ Right/ Top/ Middle/ Bottom Operation Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the Transform Pattern tool. Select two or more Patterns or/and Internal Shapes. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern/ Internal Shape) Align Left/ Center/ Right/ Top/ Middle/ Bottom The Patterns or/and Internal Shapes align to the Pattern or Internal Shape that is right clicked on. Note: You can also align Pattern outlines or Internal Lines using the 2.png Edit Pattern tool. However, be mindful that the aligning segments may transform their Patterns or Internal Shapes.

Title: Merge Symmetric Patterns
Content: Objective Merge symmetric Patterns into a single Pattern. Location Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern Outline) Merge Operation Navigate to 2D toolbar and select Edit Pattern tool. Right click on the Pattern outline of either symmetric Pattern and follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern Outline) Merge The symmetric Patterns are merged into a single Pattern as their Linked Editing function is removed. Note: When there is any point on the selected segment to merge Patterns, the Patterns cannot be merged.

Title: Optimize Curve Points
Content: Objective Optimize the number of curve points on Patterns and Internal Lines to ease the Pattern editing process (ver3.0.0). Optimize All Curve Points Location Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on 2D Window) Optimize All Curve Points Operation Follow the indicated guideline in the Location above. Optimize Curve Points dialog appears, and the number of curve points is automatically applied as an optimized ratio. (ver.7.3.0) Curve Points Adjust the ratio of curve points by a percentage (%). The closer to 0% it is, the fewer curve points there will be. But there may be deviations from the original curvature. Reset Reset the applied ratio of curve points while the dialog is running. Apply Apply the Optimize Curve Points based on the input ratio. Close Close the Optimize Curve Points dialog. Optimize Curve Points Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Transform Pattern(A), Edit Pattern(Z) 2D Toolbar Transform Pattern(A), Edit Pattern(Z) Operation Follow the indicated guideline in the Location above. Right-click your mouse on the desired patterns or segments, and select Optimize Curve Points. Optimize Curve Points dialog appears, and the number of curve points is automatically applied as an optimized ratio. (ver.7.3.0) Curve Points Adjust the ratio of curve points by a percentage (%). The closer to 0% it is, the fewer curve points there will be. But there may be deviations from the original curvature. Reset Reset the applied ratio of curve points while the dialog is running. Apply Apply the Optimize Curve Points based on the input ratio. Close Close the Optimize Curve Points dialog.

Title: Merge
Content: Objective Merge two Patterns in to a single Pattern. Location Pattern Outline Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern Sewing Line Main Menu Sewing Edit Sewing 2D Toolbar Edit Sewing Operation Pattern Outline Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern Select two Pattern outlines which two Patterns are to be merged accordingly. Note: When the Patterns are symmetrically linked, select the Pattern outline of the either Pattern. Right click on the selected Pattern outlines to access the pop-up menu. Then, select Merge. The selected two Patterns are merged based on the selected Pattern outlines. The original Pattern outlines are changed to Baselines. Sewing Line Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Sewing Edit Sewing 2D Toolbar Edit Sewing Right click on the Sewing Line which the Patterns are merged accordingly. Then, select Merge. The two Patterns sewn with the selected Sewing Line are merged based on the selected Sewing Line. The original Pattern outlines are changed to Baselines.

Title: Flip Horizontally/Vertically
Content: Objective Flip Patterns/Internal Shapes horizontally or vertically as needed. Location Main Menu Edit Context Menu 2D Pattern Flip Horizontally/ Flip Vertically (ver2.5.0) Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern) Flip Horizontally/ Flip Vertically Operation Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the Pattern Transform tool or the Edit Pattern tool. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Edit Context Menu 2D Pattern Flip Horizontally/ Flip Vertically (ver2.5.0) Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern) Flip Horizontally/ Flip Vertically The selected Patterns/ Internal Shapes are flipped horizontally or vertically.

Title: Merge Points on Internal Lines
Content: Objective Join or merge two open points on Internal Lines. Note: When a point on the Internal Line is open, it is hollow, whereas when a point on the Internal Line is closed, it is filled. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern Operation Join Overlapping Points Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern Select overlapping points and right click to access the pop-up menu. Then, select Join Overlapping Points. Two overlapping points are joined and closed. Merge to Point Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern Select two points on Internal Lines to be merged. Right click on the point which the other point should be merged to. When the pop-up menu appears, select Merge to Point. The point is merged to the right-clicked point. Merge to Average Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern Select two points on the Internal Lines to be merged. Then, right click on either point to access the pop-up menu and select Merge to Average. The selected points are merged to their average point. Intersect &amp Merge Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern Select two points to be merged. Right click on the points to access the pop-up menu and select Intersect &amp Merge. The selected points are shortened or extended maintaining their current slope and are merged where they intersect.

Title: Delete Curve Point
Content: Objective Delete unnecessary curve points when editing Patterns. When all curve points on a segment is deleted, it turns to a straight line. Location Delete Selected Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Curve Point 2D Toolbar Edit Curve Point Delete All Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Segment) Delete All Curve Points Operation Delete Selected Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Curve Point 2D Toolbar Edit Curve Point Right click on the curve point to be deleted and select Delete on the pop-up menu. Or, select the curve point and hit Delete key on the keyboard. Note: When you delete a segment point added on a curved line, all curved points on that specific line are deleted and so as the curvature. Delete All Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the 2.png Edit Pattern tool. Then, select a segment which all curved points should be deleted. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Segment) Delete All Curve Points All curve points on the selected segment are deleted.

Title: Convert to Curve Point (AI Bezier Curve)
Content: Objective Convert AI Bezier Curve's Segment Points to Free Curve Points. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern / Edit Curve Point 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern / Edit Curve Point Operation AI Bezier Curve Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern / Edit Curve Point 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern / Edit Curve Point Right click on the AI Bezier Curve or the Segment point on the curve. The right click pop-up menu appears. Select Convert to Curve Point. The selected AI Bezier curve is converted to a Free Curve as its AI Bezier curve handles disappear and necessary Free Curve Points are added to maintain its original curvature. AI Bezier Curve Handles Follow the indicated guideline: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern / Edit Curve Point 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern / Curve Point Click on the AI Bezier curve to be converted. Its AI Bezier curve handles appear. Right click on the end point of the handle and select Convert to Curve Point on the pop-up menu. Its original curvature is maintained as Free Curve Points are added.

Title: Unfold
Content: Objective Draft and unfold a half Pattern to convert and use it as a full Pattern with no center line or seam. Location Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Segment) Unfold Operation Select the Edit Pattern tool. Click on the fiducial segment that the Pattern or Internal Shape would be reflected based on. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Segment) Unfold The selected segment disappears as the Pattern unfolds.

Title: Align Points
Content: Objective Align multiple points along specific direction or axes (ver2.3.0). Location Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Points) Left / Center / Right / Top / Middle / Bottom / To Point (X-Axis) / To Point (Y-Axis) Operation Navigate to 2D toolbar and select the Edit Pattern tool. Select more than two points to be aligned. Right click on the fiducial point and follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Points) Left / Center / Right / Top / Middle / Bottom / To Point (X-Axis) / To Point (Y-Axis) The selected points are aligned according to the selected option.

Title: Edit Curve Point
Content: Objective Add and edit curve points on Pattern outlines and Internal Lines. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Curve Point 2D Toolbar Edit Curve Point Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Curve Point 2D Toolbar Edit Curve Point Click the desired position of a segment to add a curve point. The Free Curve Point is added to the segment and the straight line is curved. Click and drag to add curve point and edit curvature at once. To enter Moved Distance, please right click while click-and-dragging the Curve Point (ver4.2.0). Option Description Distance Moved Type in the how much a segment or a point is moved. X-Axis (ver4.2.0) Type in how much a point is moved on x-axis. This option does not appear for segments. Y-Axis (ver4.2.0) Type in how much a point is moved on Y-axis. This option does not appear for segments. Note: Moving multiple curve points at once is possible starting ver4.2.0 (ver4.2.0). The Transform pattern tool's selection box can now select patterns no matter the area it covers by holding CTRL and clicking and dragging your mouse. (ver. 2024.0) The Free Curve Point can be freely added and edited. The Free Curve Point can also be created by holding down the Ctrl key on the keyboard while drafting a Pattern with the Polygon tool. When a Free Curve Point is added to an AI Bezier curve, its AI Bezier curve handles disappear and the curve is reshaped based on the added Free Curve Point.

Title: Extend/Trim & Add Point to Pattern Outline or Internal Line
Content: Objective Extend or trim Internal Lines to its surrounding Pattern outline or extend or trim Internal Lines and add points to Pattern outline or other Internal Lines(ver MD10). Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern Operation Select the tool/menu indicated in Location. Right-Click on an Internal Line or Point. The pop-up menu appears. Click Extend/Trim &amp Add Point To Pattern Outline/To Internal Line (ver MD10) The Selected point is extended to the Pattern Outline or Internal Line and Points are added at the same time.

Title: Offset Pattern Outline
Content: Objective Extend or retract (ver MD10) the Pattern outline while maintaining its original shape. Location Right Click Pop-Up Menu Offset Pattern Outline Operation With the Transform Pattern tool or the Edit Pattern tool, select the entire or partial Pattern outline. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu Offset Pattern Outline The Offset Pattern Outline Window appears. Adjust following options as needed. Option Description Direction Extend Extend Pattern Outlines. Retract Retract Pattern Outlines. (ver MD10) Note: Only Distance can be modified when Retract is selected. Distance Set how much in distance the Pattern outline is extended. Number of Offsets Set the number of offsets to be created. Total Distance Total Distance = Distance x Number of Offsets Create Internal Line Create Internal Lines at where the original Pattern outlines existed. Side Segment Type Perpendicular Extends the Pattern outline perpendicular to the selected Pattern outline. Extend Side Segments Extends the Pattern outline while matching the angles of the segments on either side. Mirror Extends the Pattern outline based on the corner angle created with the selected Pattern outline and its adjacent one. Default Corner Extends the Pattern outline all around the selected segment or Pattern. Right Angled Corner Extends the Pattern outline all around the selected segment or Pattern and converting corners to right angles. Unfilled Corner Extends the Pattern outline all around the selected segment or pattern, except for corners. Click OK. The Pattern outlines are offset according to the settings. Curve points are optimized automatically. (ver MD10)

Title: Add Point/Split Line
Content: Objective Add points and split a segment into multiple segments. Just simply click or enter values to add points on segments. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Add Point/Split Line 2D Toolbar Add Point/Split Line Operation Add Point with a Click Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Add Point/Split Line 2D Toolbar Add Point/Split Line Hover the mouse over the segment where the point is to be added. Then, click once. Add Point with Entered Values Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Add Point/Split Line 2D Toolbar Add Point/Split Line Hover the mouse over the segment where the point is to be added. Right click to access the Split Line window. Enter the desired values as below: Split Into Two Lines Line 1 / Line 2 The line will be divided into two lines based on the reference point which was created when you hover the mouse over and right click the segment. The shorter side is indicated as Line 1, and the longer side is indicated as Line 2. Enter the desired value in either Line 1 or Line 2 to split the segment into two lines. Ratio The ratio of the line to be split is 100%. The line can be divided into two lines based on the ratio. Enter the desired ratio in either Line 1 or Line 2 to split the segment into two lines. This function is often used split a line into two identical segments or to add a point at its 33.3%. Split by Length Segment Length Enter the segment length which the whole line should be divided according to the interval. To reverse the direction that points are added, select Reverse Direction. Number of Segments Enter the number of segments the selected line should be divided into. It is set as 2 by default (ver3.2.0). Direction Reverse the direction that points are added (ver3.2.0). Uniform Split Enter the number of segments the line should be divided into. The line is equally divided accordingly. Note: Additional points can be added to multiple segments as they are detected as a single line. To use this function, select multiple segments where additional points should added to, right-click then select Split (ver3.2.0).

Title: Replace as Pattern Outline
Content: Objective Substitute Pattern outlines with Internal Lines, establishing the Internal Line as the new Pattern outline. Location 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern Operation Create an internal line to be substituted with the Pattern outline. Follow the indicated guideline below: 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern Click on the Internal Line and the Pattern outline that should be replaced. The Internal Line and Pattern outline are highlighted in yellow. Right-click on the selected Internal Line or Pattern outline. A pop-up menu appears. Select the Replace as Pattern Outline option. The selected Pattern outline is replaced with the shape of the Internal Line. The original Pattern outline appears as a Reference Line.

Title: Edit Curvature
Content: Objective Convert a straight line to a curved line or edit a curved line's curvature. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Curvature 2D Toolbar Edit Curvature Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Curvature 2D Toolbar Edit Curvature Click and drag a straight line to convert it to a curved line. AI Bezier handles are added to the both end of the selected line. Or, click and drag a curved line to edit the curvature.

Title: Add Point to Intersection
Content: Objective Add Segment Points to where segments intersect. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern Select the segment that is crossed. The selected segment is highlighted in yellow. Right click on the selected segment. A pop-up menu appears. Select the Add Point to Intersection option. A Segment Point is added to where the segment intersects. Note: The point is only added to the selected segment. To add points to both intersecting segments, hold down the Shift key on the keyboard and select both segment before right-clicking and selecting Add Point to Intersection option.

Title: Edit AI Bezier Curve
Content: Objective Edit AI Bezier curves with editing tools. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Curve Point or Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Curve Point or Edit Pattern Operation Edit Curvature Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Curve Point or Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Curve Point or Edit Pattern Click the point on the AI Bezier Curve to access the handle. When the handle appears, click and drag the point on the desired end of the handle to change the curvature. Note: To edit only one side's curvature, hold down the Alt key on the keyboard while click and dragging the point on the desired end of the handle. To maintain the handle's angle while changing the curvature, press down the Ctrl key on the keyboard then click and drag the curve. (ver MD10) Convert a Segment Point to an AI Bezier Curve Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Curve Point or Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Curve Point or Edit Pattern To convert a Segment Point to an AI Bezier curve, hold down the Alt key on the keyboard, and then click and drag the desired Segment Point. The selected Segment Point is converted to an AI Bezier curve as the blue handle appears. Delete Handles Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Curve Point or Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Curve Point or Edit Pattern Click the Segment Point on the curve. The pair of handles appear. Right click on the point on the desired handle to access the pop-up menu. Then, select Delete Point. Or, hit the Delete key on the keyboard. The selected handle is deleted and the curve is converted to a straight line. Note: To delete the pair of handles at once, hold down the Alt key on the keyboard and select the Segment Point on the curve.

Title: Convert to Hole/Internal Shape
Content: Objective Create a hole based on an Internal Shape or fill in a hole by converting it to an Internal Shape. Location Convert to Hole Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Internal Shape) Convert to Hole Convert to Internal Shape Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Hole) Convert to Internal Shape Operation Convert to Hole Select Transform Pattern tool or Edit Pattern tool. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Internal Shape) Convert to Hole The selected Internal Shape is converted to hole. (If you are using versions lower than ver2.3.0, Select Sync Tool.) Convert to Internal Shape Select Transform Pattern tool or Edit Pattern tool. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Hole) Convert to Internal Shape The selected hole is converted to Internal Shape. (If you are using versions lower than ver2.3.0, Select Sync tool.)

Title: Divide Internal Lines
Content: Objective Cut and separate Internal Lines or points from an Internal Shape or continuous Internal Line. Location Divide Internal Point Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on Internal Point) Divide Internal Point Divide Internal Line Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on Internal Line) Divide Internal Line Operation Divide Internal Point Select the Edit Pattern tool from the 2D toolbar. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on Internal Point) Internal Point The Internal Line is divided at the selected point. The divided point is now indicated as a point with no fill. Divide Internal Line Select the Edit Pattern tool from the 2D toolbar. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on Internal Line) Divide Internal Line The Internal Line is divided from its original Internal Shape. Both ends of the Internal Line are indicated with points with no fill.
